metadata.title: OSCAL Control Mapping — NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 (source) × NIST SP 800-171 Rev.3 (target), derived from the NIST CUI Overlay

provenance.mapping-description: Direct machine-readable rendering of the NIST SP 800-171 Rev.3 CUI Overlay spreadsheet (sp800-171r3-cui-overlay.xlsx). Only rows with Tailoring Decision = 'CUI' are retained; NCO/FED/ORC rows are tailored out per the overlay methodology. Each 800-171r3 requirement is aggregated into a single map whose sources list the 800-53r5 controls and enhancements that discharge it.
